subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: Should OpenClaw accept PR #97086's exact-head MXC plugin boundary, including `@microsoft/mxc-sdk@0.7.0`, packaged native executables, `node-pty` build allowance, and SDK argv-carried base64 config transport?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a mechanical code defect; it is a maintainer/security judgment about a new native sandbox dependency and first-party plugin support boundary.

options.title: Approve Exact-Head Boundary
options.body: Accept the native dependency and SDK transport after secops/admin review, clear the dependency-guard gate, and merge once the requested maintainer review is satisfied.

options.title: Require Transport Or Dependency Narrowing
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for a narrower package/dependency plan or an SDK path that avoids argv-carried config before merge.

options.title: Pause MXC Until Upstream Matures
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers do not want to own a first-party MXC sandbox plugin while the SDK remains preview-shaped.

recommendation.title: Approve Exact-Head Boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the native dependency and SDK transport after secops/admin review, clear the dependency-guard gate, and merge once the requested maintainer review is satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the closest merged sandbox-plugin precedent and is the live assignee for this PR's maintainer decision.
